# Senkronla

> Open-source, self-hosted Envelope Sync Relay for offline-first applications — integrate via JavaScript SDK or REST API.

Senkronla stores opaque ESR-DOC1 envelopes and coordinates multi-device sync. Spec v1.2 supports multiple named documents per namespace (`primary`, `settings`, etc.) via `EsrSync.connect({ documents: [...] })` and `/documents/{documentId}/...` REST paths.

## Agent integration (start here)

- [English overview](/agents/en.md): Architecture, checklist, concepts — links to SDK and API references
- [Turkish overview](/agents/tr.md): Mimari, kontrol listesi, kavramlar — SDK ve API referanslarına bağlantılar
